description: Source code for the 'loader.cc' implementation in the GN build system, managing file loading, toolchain states, and build configuration processing.

classes.name: SourceFileAndOrigin
classes.description: Struct holding a source file and its origin location.

classes.name: LoaderImpl::LoadID
classes.description: Struct used to identify a file load in a specific toolchain.

classes.name: LoaderImpl::ToolchainRecord
classes.description: Struct tracking the state of a specific toolchain, including settings and load status.

methods.name: Loader::Load
methods.description: Initiates loading of a build file based on a label and origin.

methods.name: LoaderImpl::Load
methods.description: Loads a source file with associated toolchain information.

methods.name: LoaderImpl::ToolchainLoaded
methods.description: Handles the event when a toolchain has finished loading.

methods.name: LoaderImpl::GetToolchainSettings
methods.description: Retrieves settings for a specified toolchain label.

methods.name: LoaderImpl::BuildFileForLabel
methods.description: Constructs the build file path for a given label.

methods.name: LoaderImpl::ScheduleLoadFile
methods.description: Schedules asynchronous loading of a source file.

methods.name: LoaderImpl::ScheduleLoadBuildConfig
methods.description: Schedules asynchronous loading of a build configuration.

methods.name: LoaderImpl::BackgroundLoadFile
methods.description: Processes the loaded file, executes its parse tree, and handles errors.

methods.name: LoaderImpl::BackgroundLoadBuildConfig
methods.description: Processes the build config, sets up scope, and handles errors.

methods.name: LoaderImpl::DidLoadFile
methods.description: Callback after a file has been loaded.

methods.name: LoaderImpl::DidLoadBuildConfig
methods.description: Callback after a build config has been loaded, updates toolchain info.

methods.name: LoaderImpl::DecrementPendingLoads
methods.description: Decrements the count of pending loads and triggers completion callback if zero.

methods.name: LoaderImpl::AsyncLoadFile
methods.description: Performs asynchronous file load, either via custom callback or default input file manager.
